stages.note: selection mode small_pool (price sampling only in cold start)

steps.policy: proposal == recorded selection (algorithm_version + display order); data_version re-query + by-id re-read of the selection; hard criteria and geographic evidence recomputed for the selected rows only

scoring_policy.formula: combined = soft_weight*(soft or 0) + behavior_weight*(appointment_weight*(appointment or 0) + browsing_weight*(browsing or 0)); missing branches contribute 0, weights never redistributed

selection_policy.tie_group: G = {i : |s_i - s_K| <= epsilon/2} around the K-th score of O; leaders = items before G
selection_policy.seeds: base = sha256(namespace|conversation|request|pool_version|selection_hash); tie/stageA/stageB streams; stability seed without request_id

cold_start.reentry: pool_key change only (a data_version-only rebuild does not re-trigger)
cold_start.no_soft_requirements: C = 0, so cold start cannot be exited without soft criteria

context.freshness: pool cache keyed by (conversation, pool_key, data_version); final gate re-queries the data version and re-reads the selection by id
